### Current evidence and source map

The checkout is pinned to 2fd89e1103a0ee1976e0e1a1210c2d4e1bb57de0. The registered public create-issue operation succeeded after direct helper invocation was hook-refused. Native Start created the #2146 actor/binding/timer normally. Missing last-known-state was normalized with native reconcile while detached and verified by GitHub readback. Direct bin/aitm.mjs draft-branch then completed with the same generation and timer start. These observations demonstrate a prevention sequence in this new checkout, not recovery of #2145.

scripts/task-tracker/draft-branch.mjs reads live board/ownership and location, then creates an undated journal and switches branches before ordinary Start renewal. It does not check the last-known-state marker before those effects. lib/native-branch-renewal.mjs enforces exact native carrier, original generation, clean physical source/index/ref/reflog, singleton owner, body/board state equality, and latest durable location equality. The final state and location checks explain why the supplied partial attempt cannot pass current renewal even after state normalization alone.

task-tracker.mjs calls enforceIssueWorktreeLocation before runVerbPreflight. lib/worktree-relocation-guard.mjs obtains the session with fallback-to-empty behavior, writes location through mutateIssueBody, and excludes reconcile from the guarded verb set. lib/issue-worktree-location.mjs validates structural history but location equality ignores SID. state.mjs loads actor timing, and lib/timing-actor.mjs rejects default-session. Together these source paths match the supplied terminal sequence: an unattributed named location can be appended before timing refuses. This is not yet a reproduced result in a disposable fixture.

verbs/reconcile.mjs accept-live stamps another visit, ignores the returned writeIssueBodyWithRetry outcome, then persists local state. Its stdout is insufficient evidence. #2146 used actual body/board readback; its second Backlog entry remains history.

Existing integration/native-branch-observation tests exercise physical Git but call the inspector directly with substituted remote reads. ### Current evidence and source map

The checkout is pinned to 2fd89e1103a0ee1976e0e1a1210c2d4e1bb57de0. The registered public create-issue operation succeeded after direct helper invocation was hook-refused. Native Start created the #2146 actor/binding/timer normally. Missing last-known-state was normalized with native reconcile while detached and verified by GitHub readback. Direct bin/aitm.mjs draft-branch then completed with the same generation and timer start. These observations demonstrate a prevention sequence in this new checkout, not recovery of #2145.

scripts/task-tracker/draft-branch.mjs reads live board/ownership and location, then creates an undated journal and switches branches before ordinary Start renewal. It does not check the last-known-state marker before those effects. lib/native-branch-renewal.mjs enforces exact native carrier, original generation, clean physical source/index/ref/reflog, singleton owner, body/board state equality, and latest durable location equality. The final state and location checks explain why the supplied partial attempt cannot pass current renewal even after state normalization alone.

task-tracker.mjs calls enforceIssueWorktreeLocation before runVerbPreflight. lib/worktree-relocation-guard.mjs obtains the session with fallback-to-empty behavior, writes location through mutateIssueBody, and excludes reconcile from the guarded verb set. lib/issue-worktree-location.mjs validates structural history but location equality ignores SID. state.mjs loads actor timing, and lib/timing-actor.mjs rejects default-session. Together these source paths match the supplied terminal sequence: an unattributed named location can be appended before timing refuses. This is not yet a reproduced result in a disposable fixture.

verbs/reconcile.mjs accept-live stamps another visit, ignores the returned writeIssueBodyWithRetry outcome, then persists local state. Its stdout is insufficient evidence. #2146 used actual body/board readback; its second Backlog entry remains history.

Existing integration/native-branch-observation tests exercise physical Git but call the inspector directly with substituted remote reads.
